Blocks.Text: This page documents all RSC API changes by version, plus documentation updates that don't map to a specific API version. Each version section uses the same sub-heading pattern (New fields, New endpoints, Renamed resources, Data Deletion, Documentation updates, Version summary) so changes are easy to scan.
This section covers all new and migrated RSC APIs from version 202507 through 202604. For migration deadlines, refer to the migration timeline. Expand each section below to view the details.
RSC currently supports the following new versioned REST APIs.

Rows.Text: Sync resumes as attachments for applications

Blocks.Text: Note
Use LinkedIn-Version: 202604 in your API requests to access the most recent features.

atsApplications renamed to applications:

Resource path changed from rest/atsApplications to rest/applications.
Supported methods: batch_update and batch_delete.
For sync request examples, refer to Sync Applications.
For delete request examples, refer to Delete Applications.
Recommended Matches and Unified Search sunset timeline
Starting December 2025, support for these widgets will end for:

New RSC partners.
Existing RSC partners when they move to the versioned Job Requisitions APIs.
Because some components of these widgets depend on the unversioned Job Postings API, both widgets will be sunset in line with the unversioned API sunset date of July 31, 2028.

Blocks.Section: Application secret management and evaluation updates
SectionPath: Application secret management and evaluation updates
Blocks.Text:
New Child Application Secret Management APIs:

Added support for rotating and deleting secrets for parent, child, and standalone applications
Partners can now maintain up to two active secrets per application, enabling zero-downtime credential updates
See Application Secret Management


Application Evaluation documentation updates:

Added evaluationClassification field to indicate candidate fit (TOP_FIT, MIGHT_BE_FIT, MIGHT_NOT_BE_FIT, UNKNOWN)
Updated criteriaClassification enum values from MATCH to MEET/DOES_NOT_MEET
See Application Evaluation Overview

Application Evaluation push notifications:

New webhook-based push notifications for application evaluations
Partners can now receive real-time updates when recruiters evaluate candidates
See Receive Push Notifications

Versioned API introduction:

Base path updated from https://api.linkedin.com/v2/ to https://api.linkedin.com/rest/ for all RSC API requests.
LinkedIn-Version: 202501 header required on all requests.
POST /v2/simpleJobPostings updated to POST /rest/simpleJobPostings; required company field added (URN format: urn:li:company:{id}).
firstName now required for all /atsCandidates requests.

Updated Sync Candidates to indicate that the firstName field is required
Updated Sync Candidates to add doNotContact field
Updated Sync Candidates updated phone number and address fields to indicate they are required but can be empty
Changed Stubprofile emailAddress field lists array of email to type string.
Limits for One Click Export updated to 300 requests per month per seat.

Updated Retrieving Closed Candidate Profiles documentation to describe expected partner behavior:
Our ATS partners must query this endpoint periodically (at least once in 30 days) and notify end customers that they may need to delete the data that appear within this endpoint from their records if they do not have a legal basis to continue processing it.
